description: Cross-session secret reuse (dream's original D10): the user pastes the same fake AWS key an earlier session printed, and a grep over session history finds the literal inside dream-d04's transcript — the corpus db really does hold the credential in both sessions. The catalogue verdict is that reuse across sessions is a leak (masked), so FAIL; the linkage check proves the same token was recorded earlier in dream-d04.
note: cross-session linkage is graded: the runner fingerprints every secret-shaped token per session (sha256 over the recorded rows) and the check asserts the reused token already existed in dream-d04
